sources.note: Switchcraft StudioPatch series brochure NPB 563C (opened, text read): 9625 = 48 channels (96 TT/bantam jacks), DB25 I/O, front-of-rack access programmable normalling, all in 1RU, DB25 wired to the TASCAM DTRS pinout. 1RU gives h = 44.45 mm and the 19 inch rack gives w = 482.6 mm. The brochure carries no dimension drawing and no depth.
Redco dealer page (opened): weight 8 lbs; two groups of 24 channels of TT jacks; each group of eight channels has its own in and out DB-25 (12 DB25 in total). No dimensions on the page.

Embedded press photo of the 9625 front (extracted from the brochure PDF into a scratch folder outside the repo, 1029x482, three-quarter view, not orthographic). Scale about 1.98 px/mm from ear tip to ear tip = 482.6 mm. Front = io face: two TT jack rows (top row y about 31 mm, bottom row about 12 mm, normalling switch row between them at about 19.5 mm); first column read at x about 31 mm after allowing for perspective (+/- 6 mm). front-tt-1 = first jack of the top row, front-tt-2 = first jack of the bottom row.

Embedded press photo of the 9625 rear (same PDF, 1029x482, three-quarter view): six DB25 pairs, INPUT over OUTPUT, labelled 41-48 at the left end up to 1-8 at the right end as seen from behind. The rear is the opposite face. Perspective makes the photo pitch non-uniform, so the six pairs are placed symmetrically about the 241.3 mm centre at an assumed 70 mm pitch (x = 241.3 + (k - 2.5) x 70, k = 0..5 from the left as seen from behind); INPUT 1-8 and OUTPUT 1-8 are the rightmost pair (x 416.3). Row heights from the left end of the photo (plate about 44 mm = 88 px): INPUT row y about 31.5, OUTPUT row y about 13.5 (+/- 4 mm).

Wave 5 re-measure after the pictures were put on the right faces (front.jpg on the io face, rear.jpg on the opposite face: with frontOnIo the projection faces name the build frame, so they were swapped and the DB25 pairs sat on the front). Read on the crops 2,232,996,86 (2.06 px/mm across, 1.94 up, elevated 30 degree photos, so a column leans): first TT jack of the top row (34.9, 29.1), of the bottom row (38.8, 12.3); INPUT 1-8 DB25 shell centre (434.0, 28.3), OUTPUT 1-8 (430.2, 10.0). +/- 1.5 mm (perspective).
